scope: Receipt precision guidance and retail historical peer comparison

criteria.criterion: 自然触发安装Money Craft并取得有效路由；无读取已有答案或验收标准
criteria.evidence: Trace loads installed Skill without explicit path in prompt; valid earnings route before research; no prior-answer/rubric reads observed.

criteria.criterion: 保持历史截止和补抓边界；发行人材料不冒充独立双源
criteria.evidence: Answer retains historical cutoff, execution date, historical identity and issuer-only evidence limitation; no current valuation claim.

criteria.criterion: 区分真实财年结束日、52/53周及Walmart海外合并滞后，不强行年化为同口径增长
criteria.evidence: Actual fiscal windows, 52/53 weeks and one-month foreign consolidation lag identified; no mechanical annualization.

criteria.criterion: 正确识别Target Net sales包含其他收入，Costco及Walmart另列收入；统一并说明计算分母
criteria.evidence: Total revenue denominator aligned and Target Net sales explicitly includes other revenue; Costco/Walmart extra income not double-counted.

criteria.criterion: 使用Target重分类后比较列，不将重分类解释为经营效率提升
criteria.evidence: Target current comparison columns and cost reclassification identified; no operating-profit benefit attributed to reclassification.

criteria.criterion: 关键增长/利润率计算与原文一致且回执完整；报告同比不冒充同店增长
criteria.evidence: 23 final receipts verified; reported growth, approximate extra-week adjustment and same-store growth distinguished; FCF proxy limited.

criteria.criterion: 区分集团与Sam’s Club分部，不用集团市值套分部盈利作为PE；可比组理由落到业务差异
criteria.evidence: Business-based peer subgroups; Sam’s Club operating comparison does not become independently traded valuation; no group/segment multiple mixing.

criteria.criterion: 缺同日价格/资本结构/盈利预期时不编造倍数、目标价或安全边际；给出具体补证条件
criteria.evidence: No unsupported price targets or multiples; missing historical prices, capital structure, TTM and normalization inputs listed with next observation windows.

limits: Single controlled historical case, not broad forecasting or comps accuracy proof
Independent second-source financial verification and valuation data remain absent
Semantic criteria reviewed by parent; arithmetic audit does not validate investment claims
Not a formal money archive or release; no commit or push
